title: net/http wrapped behind a small RateClient with tests against a local server

must_not_find.why: *http.Client is injected once and never leaves RateClient; callers see only Rate
net/http is touched in one type only; this is the wrapper
each error check is a single-line Go idiom, and wrapping adds context
the http client is constructed by the caller and injected through NewRateClient
tests use an in-process httptest server; they are fast, independent, and offline
